categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Headman Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the design, development, production, and sales of high-precision CNC lathes. Its main product categories include high-end CNC lathes (T series), automated production lines, parallel composite machining centers, and popular CNC lathes. These products serve industries such as automotive manufacturing, engineering machinery, general equipment, aerospace, and military industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on core technologies including spindle technology, servo turret technology, servo tailstock technology, and thermal compensation. It has achieved full localization of key components like spindles, turrets, and tailstocks. The company also develops its own CNC system (Headman system) emphasizing intelligence, automation, and high precision. Production employs modular and unitized manufacturing systems, supporting parallel and composite machining technologies, including five-axis linkage and automation integration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are from automotive parts manufacturing, engineering machinery, general machinery, aerospace, and military sectors. The company targets high-precision machining needs in these industries, including components for new energy vehicles, aerospace parts, and military-grade equipment. It also serves overseas markets in Europe, North America, and Southeast Asia, expanding its export footprint.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Zhejiang Province (Yuhuan Puqing and Shamen bases) and Shanghai (Lingang base). It has established sales and service networks domestically and internationally, with significant market penetration in Europe, North America, and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Headman operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer of CNC machine tools and automated production equipment. It produces core components in-house and sources some key parts like CNC systems and linear guides from specialized suppliers, including foreign brands. The company integrates upstream R&D and downstream sales and service functions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on high-precision, high-efficiency, and intelligent CNC machine tools. R&D priorities include advancing spindle and thermal compensation technologies, developing the Headman CNC system with intelligent and automated features, and expanding composite machining capabilities such as five-axis linkage. It emphasizes innovation through autonomous development, university collaborations, and joint ventures with CNC system manufacturers. The company also invests in automation and industrial software development to enhance smart manufacturing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of CNC machine tools, automated production lines, and related components. Sales channels include direct sales domestically and distributor-based sales in overseas markets. The company also earns from after-sales services and customized automation solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the high-end CNC lathe market against established international brands from Germany, Japan, the USA, and Taiwan, as well as domestic competitors with strong mid-to-high-end capabilities. Headman positions itself as a specialist in high-precision CNC lathes with a focus on innovation and automation, aiming to increase its market share through technology leadership and expanding export markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 663.56 million, a 5.16% increase from the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 29.44 million, down 50.71% due to increased depreciation and R&D expenses. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.45 billion, with steady growth in revenue and investment in capacity expansion. R&D spending increased to 6.41% of revenue, reflecting a commitment to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Headman emphasizes high precision, automation, and intelligent manufacturing capabilities as its core value proposition. Its products feature proprietary core technologies such as electric spindles, servo turrets, and thermal compensation, enabling high rigidity and accuracy. The company’s parallel composite machining centers and automation solutions offer enhanced efficiency and flexibility, catering to complex and customized machining needs. Its integrated industrial software and CNC system development further differentiate its offerings by enabling smart, automated production processes.
